body.statement: For the one-proxy graph in Figure 3 of Tramontano et al. (2025), the causal target in their Theorem 3.5 is the structural coefficient on the directed edge from the observed treatment \(T\) to the observed outcome \(Y\), denoted there by \(b_{Y,T}\).

source.verbatim_statement: “the causal effect from T to Y” (Theorem 3.5); “Since b_{Y,T} is unconstrained in ℝ², it is not generically identifiable” (Theorem 3.6 proof).

attestation.note: Verified against PMLR source-of-record PDF page 5 and Figure 3: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v267/main/assets/tramontano25a/tramontano25a.pdf
